ev.q: As of November 1 in Saudi Arabia, 516 persons with suspected severe RVF* requiring hospitalization have been reported
125 (76%) of 165 case-patients reported close contact with animals, especially sheep and goats
516 persons with suspected severe RVF* requiring hospitalization have been reported from primary health-care centers and hospitals ( Figure 1 ); 87 (17%) have died.
Of the 216 suspected severe case-patients with appropriate serum samples, 206 (95%) have been laboratory confirmed
The mean duration from disease onset to hospitalization was 3.3 days (standard deviation [SD]= ±3.2 days)

public_health_question.v: What are the extent, clinical features, exposures and vectors of the first Rift Valley fever outbreak on the Arabian peninsula, in Saudi Arabia?

ev.q: This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation conducted by the Saudi Arabian MOH in collaboration with CDC
Update: Outbreak of Rift Valley Fever --- Saudi Arabia, August--November 2000
This report updates the findings of the ongoing investigation conducted by the Saudi Arabian MOH in collaboration with CDC
Suspected cases have been identified through an elaborate pre-existing system of primary health-care centers that refer acutely ill persons to district hospitals
Based on preliminary data from the ongoing epidemiologic investigation, 125 (76%) of 165 case-patients reported close contact with animals

equity.level_reason: Nationality of case-patients (Saudi, Yemeni, other) is reported only as a descriptor of the case series; age and sex likewise describe the cases. No group-specific outcomes are reported.

level_alternative.reason: Citizenship shares are case composition in an international outbreak report, which could be read as a characteristic rather than an equity descriptor.

ev.q: 424 (82%) were Saudi citizens, 80 (16%) were Yemeni citizens, and 12 (2%) were of other nationalities.
the median age was 46 years (range: 1--95 years)

equity.equity_measurement: Nationality is case composition only, with no denominators by group.

notes: Descriptive case series within an outbreak investigation: counts, proportions, case fatality and mean onset-to-hospitalization and onset-to-death intervals, with no comparisons between groups. Ungulate antibody prevalence (>90%) and mosquito isolates are entomologic and veterinary findings; the area 'correlation' is qualitative, not a computed coefficient.
view_issues: Jazan (365 [77%]) and Asir (122 [24%]) sum to more than 100% of 516 cases; the percentages appear to use different denominators.
